summary: The owner-proposed universal bound on E||rho_(U^T X|Z)||_infinity^(2/3) after conditioning on the full orthogonal spectral complement is false. For three independent m-coordinate uniform cube blocks and U the three normalized block-sum directions, the exact moment is m^(-1)[Gamma(m+1)Gamma(4/3)/Gamma(m+1/3)]^3 > Gamma(4/3)^3 m. The same obstruction occurs for the full-rank target matrix with spectrum {1,1,-1,1/128,...,1/128}. This does not refute QFORM: the rank-three form is bounded by 4 sqrt(pi) using the Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov one-dimensional marginal theorem plus account04/B18 dependent-square smoothing, and for m>=32 the full-rank perturbation has continuous density <64 by the completed spectral-window theorem.
replacement_obligation: Keep original-coordinate randomness unconditioned through an aggregate smoothing step; pursue an exhaustive aggregate/ridge versus high-leverage grouped-coordinate dichotomy instead of conditioning on the entire spectral complement.
